message.content: A structured wool-blend blazer in charcoal grey (#3E4548) with a relaxed shoulder cut to skim the torso, paired with high-waisted pleated trousers in deep forest green (#2D4F37). Underneath, choose a fine-gauge merino knit top in oat cream (#EDD0A1) featuring a draped neckline to soften the upper chest and subtly draw attention upward away from the midsection. Footwear consists of polished leather loafers in black oxblood (#650B0B) with a slight heel for comfort during long office hours. This outfit works because the textured fabrics add visual interest that distracts from the belly zone while maintaining professional polish, and the color palette creates a slimming vertical line appropriate for an autumn day in the office.
